<section class="color-yellow clients" spl-critical="" spl-id="com-page-header-type-2" spl-static="">
<div class="content">
<div class="wrapper">
<h1>
<span class="toggle-option toggle-default" toggle-bind="portfolio" toggle-group="level">
                        Connect Portfolio, Products and Teams                    </span>
<span class="toggle-option" toggle-bind="program" toggle-group="level">
                        Get visibility across the entire value flow                    </span>
<span class="toggle-option" toggle-bind="team" toggle-group="level">
                        Scrum, Kanban..<br/>Let your teams decide                    </span>
</h1>
<div class="toggler">
<div class="" data-slave="level" spl-critical="" spl-id="com-header-toggle-bar">
<div class="toggles">
<div class="runner"></div>
<ul>
<li data-default="true" data-value="portfolio">
                        Portfolio                    </li>
<li data-value="program">
                        Program                    </li>
<li data-value="team">
                        Team                    </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="text">
<div class="toggle-option color-red toggle-default" toggle-bind="portfolio" toggle-group="level">
<p>Targetprocess is a visual platform to help you adopt and scale agile across your enterprise. Use SAFe, LeSS or implement your own framework to achieve business agility and see the value flow through the entire organization.</p> </div>
<div class="toggle-option color-blue" toggle-bind="program" toggle-group="level">
<p>Targetprocess provides visibility into product increments and delivery cycles at the product and program levels. Scale Agile across enterprise using SAFe, LeSS, Spotify or any scaled agile framework.</p> </div>
<div class="toggle-option color-green" toggle-bind="team" toggle-group="level">
<p>Targetprocess gives teams the freedom to choose their ways of working keeping focus on a big picture. Marketing, Operations and R&amp;D can finally work in one tool, synchronize priorities and align work with company goals.</p> </div>
</div>

<section spl-id="com-integrations" spl-static="">
<div class="content">
<h2>Integrations</h2>
<div class="columns">
<div class="col text">
<p>Targetprocess offers integrations with 60+ apps. These are native integrations that are embedded in
             the system (such as DevOps integrations with GitHub, GitLab, BitBucket and Azure DevOps, Phabricator
             and other tools), and additional integrations that are available through the <b><a href="/guide/integrations/tasktop/tasktop-integration-hub/">Integration Hub</a></b>.</p> </div>
<div class="col links">

<!-- --><!-- --> </div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
